description: Personal knowledge management framework based on Tiago Forte's "The PARA Method" and "Building a Second Brain". Use this skill whenever the user is discussing personal knowledge management, note-taking systems, digital organization, or how to turn information into output — even if they do not explicitly say "PARA," "Second Brain," "CODE," or "progressive summarization." Triggers include: (1) organizing digital information into Projects, Areas, Resources, and Archives, (2) building a Second Brain for capturing and retrieving knowledge, (3) applying CODE methodology (Capture, Organize, Distill, Express), (4) designing progressive summarization layers, (5) deciding where to file a new piece of information or note, (6) feeling overwhelmed by notes apps, bookmarks, or scattered files, (7) struggling to retrieve insights from past research, customer interviews, or strategy work, (8) setting up or auditing a notes app, knowledge base, or folder structure across multiple tools.
